notes: «تابعه عبدة عن عبيد الله» is a second isnad after the saying, carrying the same saying: a second group. Its route stops at Ubayd Allah; the text writes no further names for it.
«قال عبيد الله فيعجبني» is Ubayd Allah's own remark inside the saying, not a second chain.
«أبيه» is Ka'b b. Malik, named only by relation: relation link, and the last link of the first route.
